summary: Full iteration-4 regression on public URL. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py pass (portal gating, siswa scoping, incoming books flow, lost/found with reports, member history, settings CRUD, members without email/phone). Frontend: portal chooser renders; /admin login as petugas works; incoming form creates N books (verified 2 TEST_UI2_Buku rows); lost-book flow turns status 'Hilang', found-button appears and restores to 'Tersedia'; member form has only name/student_id/class_name (no email/phone), card shows school & library logos, history panel renders; CardDesigner theme-emerald + layout-portrait apply classes to preview, save persists (restored to navy/classic); Reports incoming/missing/transactions tabs work; siswa login on /admin shows exact error text 'Akun siswa hanya dapat masuk melalui portal /siswa'; /siswa portal: all 4 tabs work, 9 catalog cards, kartu shows card, riwayat shows history, no admin-only buttons visible, visiting /admin as siswa redirects to /siswa, student-logout works.

issues: 'Sumber' is a <select> (Pembelian/Donasi/...) not a free-text input as request implied. Not a bug, just a note for test authors.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses in-memory lockout dict; survives per-process only, lost on restart — acceptable for school app but worth noting.
Lost/Found uses window.prompt/confirm (browser blocking dialogs) — hard to test headlessly and poor UX; consider a small modal.
Dashboard 'incoming' now derived from real incoming collection (was hardcoded in iter3) — fixed.
Portal gating is enforced server-side (good). Frontend also redirects siswa away from /admin.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI2_Buku x2 via incoming form in UI test and deleted them. Backend tests create TEST_INC_*/TEST_SUM_*/TEST_REP_* books via /api/incoming and clean them up via DELETE. One TEST_ member and settings mutations are restored to defaults. Lost book created during test is restored to Tersedia.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 features verified green. Note: 'incoming-source-input' is a <select>; use select_option in Playwright. Lost/Found uses window.prompt + window.confirm — register page.on('dialog', d: d.accept()) before clicking. Siswa portal login error exact text: 'Akun siswa hanya dapat masuk melalui portal /siswa'. Previous iter3 left stale TEST_UI_INC books in catalog (title: TEST_UI_INC x2), harmless but may clutter counts.
